name: Italy

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, tourism, up to 90 days)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen fee per Regulation (EC) 810/2009, raised from EUR 80 to EUR 90 on 11 June 2024. Children 6-12: EUR 45; under 6: free; study/research (C) visas: free; EU-citizen family members: free. Consulates collect the local-currency equivalent, adjusted quarterly (e.g. USD 105.50 at Embassy Washington, Apr-Jun 2026).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, business)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen C fee as tourism; no separate business tariff.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.applies: nationalities subject to airport transit visa requirement
fees.notes: VFS/consular fee schedules list Categories A, B or C at the same EUR 90 uniform fee.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, for visa-exempt nationals)
fees.applies: visa-exempt non-EU nationalities (once ETIAS becomes operational)
fees.notes: EU-level authorisation, not Italy-specific. Fee set at EUR 20 (raised from the originally legislated EUR 7); free for under-18s and over-70s. Not yet in operation as of the record date - verify launch status before relying on it.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced Schengen fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (Embassy Washington lists USD 41.10 equivalent, Apr-Jun 2026). The EU-Russia facilitation agreement is suspended, so Russian nationals pay the full EUR 90. No special rates for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CAN (USA/GBR/CAN are visa-exempt for short stays).

vfs.note: Published VFS Global service charge per application in India (Bengaluru/Chennai/Hyderabad/Mumbai, effective Apr 2026), incl. taxes. Service fees vary by country and centre; optional premium-lounge/courier services cost extra. Italy also uses other outsourcers in some countries.

free_visa_notes: No e-visa or visa on arrival exists for Italy; all visas are embassy/consulate-issued Schengen or national visas. Schengen C visas are free for children under 6, study (C) and research (C) applicants, and family members of EU citizens. Italy also charges a national long-stay (Type D) visa fee (approx. EUR 116; Embassy Washington lists USD 136 for Apr-Jun 2026), outside the scope of this short-stay record.
